row:
Lansing Community College is one of the largest community colleges in Michigan, serving more than 13,000 students each year. It offers more than 200 degree and certificate programs with online, in-person, hybrid and hy-flex class formats, in addition to career and workforce development and personal enrichment options for learners of all ages. 

The college was founded in 1957 and has since grown from its flagship campus in downtown Lansing to include locations in Delta Township, East Lansing and Mason. LCC is consistently named one of Michigan's best community colleges, and students enjoy unsurpassed instruction, beautiful facilities, cutting-edge technology and comprehensive support services to help them succeed.
